payload.reasoning: Violates the property of correctly parsing HTML by not checking for meta charset elements.
payload.aftercode: Elements metaElements = doc.select("meta[http-equiv=content-type], meta[charset]"); String foundCharset = null; for (Element meta : metaElements) { if (meta.hasAttr("http-equiv")) foundCharset = getCharsetFromContentType(meta.attr("content")); if (foundCharset == null && meta.hasAttr("charset")) foundCharset = meta.attr("charset"); }
